articles.title: Ace Hardware Ranks No. 4 on Entrepreneur's Franchise 500®, No. 1 in Category for Fifth Straight Year
articles.mainIdea: Ace Hardware Ranks No. 4 on Entrepreneur's Franchise 500®, No. 1 in Category for Fifth Straight Year
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Ace Hardware Ranks No. 4 on Entrepreneur's Franchise 500®, No. 1 in Category for Fifth Straight Year. Ace Hardware, the world's largest hardware cooperative, has been ranked No. 4 on Entrepreneur magazine's Franchise 500® list, moving up one spot in the annual ranking of the world's top franchise systems. Ace Hardware was also named the No. 1 franchise in the 'Miscellaneous Retail Businesses' category for the fifth consecutive year, reinforcing the strength and consistency of its cooperative model.
